name: Bageri Passion
comment: this is my favorate place, great taste bread, friendly staff, and cozy enviroment

name: Käcks Bageri
comment: sour dough bread is okay, but the environment is not mine. It has no table inside with only open kitchen which i have no interest.

name: Nockeby Bageri
comment: sour dough bread is good, bullar are good, environment is good. And the bread is baked by themselves. This is not a chain cafe. Very good.

name: Park Bageri & Konditori
comment: good taste, hand made, self-baking. good environment

name: Restaurang Bazaar
comment: bad taste food, it was pre-made, we don't like it

name: Green Rabbit
comment: Very disappointing. The pastry chef on duty was not the Michelin-pedigree chef but an intern. The shop is small and run-down. The food did not taste good either.

name: Socker Sucker
comment: Loved it. Saw the famous pastry chef in person. Pastries are refined and inventive, and the bread is also very good. Downside: not kid-friendly, no high chairs.
